$description: Pedestal public storefront, measured 2026-11-19 from www.pedestal.com. Light only. The Shopify Customer Account host is a separate system and is not tokenised here.

$extensions.source: Measured. theme.styles.css @font-face FK Display 400, stack .font-display
Measured. theme.styles.css @font-face Suisse Intl 400/500/600, stack .font-sans_serif
Measured. .fs-title-display-4xl is 160px. Computed on the home hero h2: FK Display 400, line-height 160px, letter-spacing -6.4px, color white.
Measured. .fs-title-display-2xl is 56px. Computed on collection and contact h1: FK Display 400, line-height 56px, letter-spacing -2.24px.
Measured. .fs-title-display-xl is 32px. Computed on the Viva product h1: FK Display 400, line-height 32px, letter-spacing -1.28px.
Measured. .fs-title-s is 1.1875rem / 120% / -0.02375rem Suisse Intl. Computed 19px, 22.8px, -0.38px on the cart title row.
Measured. .fs-title-s-bold weight 500. Computed on 'Your cart'.
Measured. Header nav and .fs-nav-item-regular: Suisse Intl 15px, line-height 22.5px, letter-spacing -0.15px, weight 400.
Measured. .fs-misc-cta on the Add to cart label: Suisse Intl 15px, weight 500, line-height 18px, letter-spacing -0.15008px.
Measured. Contact field .fs-misc-label with !text-[16px]: Suisse Intl 16px, line-height 19.2px, letter-spacing -0.15008px.
Measured. .fs-text-xs is 0.8125rem / 140% / -0.00813rem. Computed 13px, 18.2px, -0.13008px on the terms link.
Measured. .fs-nav-item-featured uppercase: 0.8125rem / 150% / 0.04063rem. Computed 13px, 19.5px, 0.65008px, color black at 65%.
Measured. .fs-gallery-caption: 11px, line-height 140%, letter-spacing 0.05em, weight 600, uppercase, Suisse Intl. 15.4px and 0.55px are 140% and 0.05em of 11px.
Measured. .rounded-sm is 0.125rem. Computed 2px on nav chips and the grey menu button.
Measured. .rounded-md is 0.25rem. Computed 4px on Add to cart, Send, contact fields, and filter tiles.
Measured. Colour chips use .rounded-full, computed 9999px, 24px rest diameter.
Measured. .gap-0.5 and .px-0.5 are 0.125rem.
Measured. .p-1 and .gap-1 are 0.25rem. Send button padding is 4px.
Measured. .gap-2 and .p-2 are 0.5rem. Contact field rows use gap-[8px] and mb-[8px].
Measured. .px-2.5 is 0.625rem. Nav item horizontal padding is 10px.
Measured. .px-3 is 0.75rem. Contact inputs use px-3.
Measured. .p-4 is 1rem. Search field padding is 16px.
Measured. .gap-6 is 1.5rem.
Measured. .gap-10 is 2.5rem.
Measured. :root --header-height and --header-mobile-height are 3rem. Computed header height 48px.
Measured. Contact field wrapper h-[4.625rem], computed 74px. Add to cart and Send are also 74px.
Measured. Home CTA h-[3.5rem], computed 56px at the 1169px fill viewport before the desktop grid.
Measured. .duration-150 is .15s. .transition-all and .transition-colors default to .15s.
Measured. .duration-300 is .3s. Header, nav, Add to cart and Send use duration-300.
Measured. .transition-all timing-function cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). Computed on header buttons.
Measured. .ease-out is cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1). Colour chips transition width with ease-out.
Measured. body.bg-off_white-light computed rgb(250, 250, 250). .bg-off_white-light is rgba(250,250,250,1). :root --header-background is #fafafa.
Measured. .bg-off_white-medium is rgba(245,245,245,1).
Measured. Contact field wrapper computed rgba(33, 33, 33, 0.05), class bg-black-5. .bg-black-5 is the same.

Measured. body color computed rgb(33, 33, 33). .text-black-100 is rgb(33, 33, 33). :root --header-color is #212121.
Measured. .text-black-65 is rgba(33, 33, 33, 0.65). Computed on .fs-nav-item-featured.
Measured. .text-black-45 is rgba(33, 33, 33, 0.45). Computed on 'Start adding products.'
Measured. .text-grey-dark is rgba(96,96,96,1).
Measured. Add to cart label computed rgb(255, 255, 255).
Measured. Send button computed color rgb(255, 255, 255). .text-white-100 is rgba(255,255,255,1).
Measured. Header over the home hero computed color rgb(255, 255, 255).
Measured. .text-blue-regular is rgba(10,74,253,1). Same blue as the action fill.
Measured. .text-error is rgba(255,71,71,1). Distinct from :root --color-error #de4438.

Measured. .border-black-100 is rgb(33, 33, 33).

Measured. Add to cart computed rgb(10, 74, 253).
Measured. Add to cart label computed rgb(255, 255, 255).
Measured. Add to cart computed border-radius 4px.
Measured. Add to cart computed height 74px at 1440 CSS px.
Measured. Send computed rgb(33, 33, 33).
Measured. Send computed color rgb(255, 255, 255).
Measured. Send computed border-radius 4px.
Measured. Send computed height 74px.
Measured. Send computed padding 4px.
Measured. Contact field wrapper computed rgba(33, 33, 33, 0.05).
Measured. Contact input computed color rgb(33, 33, 33).
Measured. Contact field wrapper computed border-radius 4px.
Measured. Contact field wrapper computed height 74px.
Measured. Header nav over the home hero computed rgb(255, 255, 255).
Measured. Nav chips computed border-radius 2px.
Measured. Configure chip computed height 31.5px, rounded.

notTokenised: :root --color-error is #de4438. .text-error is #ff4747. Both are recorded in raw/readings.json. The text role uses the class that paints error copy.
Rebuy widget colours (#2491C4, #44BE70, 5px radius) are a third-party search skin, not the Pedestal theme.
Shopify Customer Account (shopify.com) uses Helvetica Neue, #f6f6f6 page, #005bd1 links, 12px fields. It is a different system and is not in this file.
No dark theme. color-scheme is light. theme.styles.css has zero prefers-color-scheme: dark rules and zero prefers-reduced-motion rules.
No box-shadow elevation on the measured controls. .shadow-sm resolves to an empty Tailwind shadow. Filter tiles declare shadow-sm.
